title: Say Subok na Sagradon Pinalsa
intro: Sakey a tanda so nibaki ed sakey a bansan abalang. Diad kapegleyan na komportablen bilay da et sinmabi so sakey a pasakbay—ya kaiba toy sakey a makatantandan pinalsa a magmaliw a sankagrabian a subok ed pananisia ra. Say ebat da so mamaseguro ed kapalaran da ed andi-anggaan. Naamtaan mo kasi no siopay angiter ed sayan pasakbay tan antoy agawa ed saramay ag-angawat ed satan?
clues: Sikatayo so totoon inwanwan na saray akaunan mensahero ya akauna nen sikami.
Sakey a makapadinayew a pinalsa so pinmaway ed palandey, sakey a tanda a nanlapud Katawan tayo parad sayan bansa.
Inkuan ko ed sikara: 'Saya so kabatyan a kamelyo a kayarian nen Allah, kanian paulyanan yo ya mangan ed dalin nen Allah tan agyo diwiten na mauges.'
Balet pinuter na saray totoo so ulpo na kabatyan a kamelyok, ya ag da labay so ganggan na Katawan da.
Sakey ak labat a mensahero na Katawan mo, ya imbaki a kaibak so katwaan—sakey ak a napanmatalkan a propita tan aripen.
Nipaakar ed saray managgaway mauges, kinabil ira na Katawan tayo na maksil a tanol, tan ag ira makagalaw ed kaabungan da.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Si Propeta Hud na saray totoo ed A'ad
Propeta Salih na saray totoo nen Thamud
Propeta Shu'aib na Midian
Propeta Lut na saray totoo ed Sodoma
Si Propeta Nuh na Kaban
identity.answer: Propeta Salih na saray totoo nen Thamud

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say Delap ya amalereg ed agmananisia a nasyon
Say yegyeg ya aneral ed makasalanan a syudad
Say kabatyan a kamelyo so imbaki bilang madibinon tanda tan subok
Say bagyo ya anusa ed saray totood Midian
Say impamatey ed saray totoo nen Lot diad panamegley na saray bato
trial.answer: Say kabatyan a kamelyo so imbaki bilang madibinon tanda tan subok

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say syudad na Sodoma ed Patar na Jordan
Say lawak na Al-Hijr ed baetan na Hijaz tan Syria
Say kadaanan a dalin na A'ad diad abalaten na Arabia
Saray katakelan na Midian ya asingger ed Ambalangan Dayat
Saray patar na Palandey Judi diad Mesopotamia
location.answer: Say lawak na Al-Hijr ed baetan na Hijaz tan Syria

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nilaban ira kayari ran nagbabawi tan anisia
Sigpot iran dineral na uran na bato
Sakey a maksil a tanol so amawala ed sikara ya ag-ira makagalaw
Sikaray inawit na maksil a dagem
Inakmon ira na yegyeg ed dalin
outcome.answer: Sakey a maksil a tanol so amawala ed sikara ya ag-ira makagalaw

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
